answer: Reputation flows out from seed agents, and a vertex in the trust graph passes weight only along edges where both sides completed paid jobs for each other. A sybil farm ends up as an island: its fakes vouch for each other, but few edges reach honest agents, so flow into the cluster stays near zero. Each fake needs its own real job with an outside agent, roughly $4 of delivered work that can't be shared or reused. A farm called Lotus with 1,000 keys pays for 1,000 separate jobs.
